Epiphaneia looks blankly/dazed
(Enamored by the Trainer's expression)

Yeah! Plus there's a stage right there!
You remember all my solo songs, don't you? C'mon, c'mon!

Hearing Epiphaneia say that reminds me of the time
she left me in the dust when I tried to pace her on a bicycle.
Haha, my bad, my bad! C'mon, let's test it out already!

You'll be fine! You've got guts, Trainer! And above all else,
I'm saying we can do it together! Come on, let's both give it our all!

It's a kind of resistance training!
I'll run while pulling you in it!

All right! Let's head back soon, then!
After singing our hearts out like that, I'm gonna sleep like a log tonight!

I'm down! ...Ah, if we're going, that ramen shop in the shopping district would be awesome.
I wanna take on their challenge bowl! The Voice of Destiny is telling me to do it, too!

Ahaha! I love ramen 'cause you can just slurp it down all at once!
Though your final sprint was pretty cool too, Trainer!

A sense of accomplishment fills my heart...
And at the same time, an overwhelming fullness hits my stomach.

Could you spare me some of your time?!
I want to bestow upon you the 'Voice of Destiny'!

Yeah! Let's go for a run outside!
There's something I want to try out!

What are you spacing out for?
You didn't even notice me coming over—

Whoa, what was that face just now?! That was awesome!!
Could you do it again?!

The Voice of Destiny says right now is the time!
Come on, let's go! Right now! Hurry, hurry!
It builds my core, and this way I won't leave you behind either, right?

Our daily routine has evolved from how it used to be—
She's no longer just running wild all on her own.

It's just the two of us here! Let's sing our hearts out!
The Voice of Destiny says we should go for it, too!

The one from earlier! I really wanna see it one more time!
Come on, please? Do it right now, Trainer!!

Epiphaneia kept pestering me for a while after that,
but I couldn't recreate it.

Nah, never mind! Scratch that!
There's something I gotta tell that girl over there!

Quite a few days have passed since I signed a contract with Epiphaneia.
Our dynamic—where I used to get left behind constantly—is starting to change.

Mmm... We were in top form all day today!
Don't you think so, Trainer?!

Is that so? Then I know a much better way than resting.
Post-meal exercise! Let's sing together!

It's smaller than the Umamusume-sized portion brought out earlier,
but the sheer volume is still intimidating.
Alright, hop into that rickshaw over there!

—Taking her up on the suggestion and singing felt surprisingly refreshing.
Having her beside me, having the time of her life, probably helped a lot too.
—ainer... Trainer!!
HRAAAAAAAAH!!!!

A new regimen? Shuttle runs come first!
The Voice of Destiny says that's what'll work best right now!

A meeting?
Yeah, totally! Let's do it right away—

See? Felt great, right?
You were totally getting into it halfway through, Trainer!

Phew, that was a good sweat!
...Whoops, my stomach's starting to make some noise too!
Look, yours is here too! Extra-large ramen, human edition!

Challenge bowl, total victoryyyyy!!
See? It was totally fine, wasn't it, Trainer?!
